address: 30 Charlotte Street, Fitzrovia, London, W1T 2NG, United Kingdom
bio: This Fitzrovian funhouse is Chef Nuno Mendes’ ‘love letter’ to Lisbon and he’s on a mission to showcase its vibrant and varied food and wine cultures, and bring them to the attention of a wider audience. Come with a group of friends to best sample the array of petiscos, plates, pots and platters, all bursting with colour, freshness and flavour. The atmosphere is celebratory, lively and unabashedly noisy....
